title: Philistines Reject David

questions.question: Who objected to David going into battle with the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:3-4 (ESV): “...But the commanders of the Philistines were angry... ‘Send the man back... lest in the battle he become an adversary to us.’”

questions.question: What did the commanders fear David would do?
options: Turn against them to reconcile with his master
questions.correctAnswer: Turn against them to reconcile with his master
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:4 (ESV): “...For how could this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Would it not be with the heads of the men here?”

questions.question: What song did the Philistines quote?
options: Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands
questions.correctAnswer: Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:5 (ESV): “Is not this David... ‘Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

questions.question: Did Achish find fault with David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:6 (ESV): “...I have found nothing wrong in you from the day of your coming to me...”

questions.question: What did David do the next morning?
options: Rose early and departed to return to the land of the Philistines (Ziklag)
questions.correctAnswer: Rose early and departed to return to the land of the Philistines (Ziklag)
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:11 (ESV): “So David set out with his men early in the morning to return...”

questions.question: Achish compared David to an ______ of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:9 (ESV): "...I know that you are as blameless in my sight as an angel of God."

questions.question: Where were the Philistines gathering their forces?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:1 (ESV): "Now the Philistines had gathered all their forces at Aphek..."

questions.question: Where were the Israelites encamped?
options: By the spring that is in Jezreel
questions.correctAnswer: By the spring that is in Jezreel
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:1 (ESV): "...And the Israelites were encamped by the spring that is in Jezreel."

questions.question: How did the lords of the Philistines pass by?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:2 (ESV): "As the lords of the Philistines were passing on by hundreds and by thousands..."

questions.question: David and his men were passing on in the ______ with Achish.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:2 (ESV): "...David and his men were passing on in the rear with Achish."

questions.question: What did David say to Achish's command to leave?
options: But what have I done? Why may I not fight?
questions.correctAnswer: But what have I done? Why may I not fight?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:8 (ESV): "And David said to Achish, 'But what have I done?... that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?'"

questions.question: Achish swore by whom that David was honest?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:6 (ESV): "Then Achish called David and said to him, 'As the LORD lives, you have been honest...'" (Notable that a Philistine invokes Yahweh, or the narrator translates it so).

questions.question: The Princes of the Philistines said, "What are these ______ doing here?"
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:3 (ESV): "Then the commanders of the Philistines said, 'What are these Hebrews doing here?'"

questions.question: Achish referred to David as the servant of ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:3 (ESV): "...Is not this David, the servant of Saul king of Israel..."

questions.question: Where did the Philistines go up to after David left?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:11 (ESV): "...But the Philistines went up to Jezreel."

key_verse_text: Achish answered David, “I know that you are as blameless in my sight as an angel of God. Nevertheless, the commanders of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’” (ESV)
